title: Recording: Venus And Mars (Reprise) by Wings | 1975
content:
Sea-Saint Recording Studio, New Orleans
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Alan O’Duffy, Ken Laxton, Roberta Grace

Wings recorded the song ‘Venus And Mars (Reprise)’ on 22 January 1975.

The recording had Paul McCartney on guide vocals and acoustic guitar, Linda McCartney on piano, Denny Laine on bass guitar, and Geoff Britton playing cymbals.

This was Britton’s final recording session with Wings; he was fired from the group that evening. During this session, McCartney realised that the drummer was not gelling with the music or the personnel within the band. He took arranger Tony Dorsey to one side and asked if he knew a suitable replacement. Dorsey recommended Joe English, who arrived in New Orleans on the same night.
